cases.expected_summary: 客戶詢問方案降級是否會影響歷史工單資料的保存。

cases.input_text: 我們這批新進客服大概 8 個人，下週要上線，想請問有沒有現成的教育訓練影片或是可以安排一場線上教學，讓他們快速上手 NebulaDesk？
cases.draft_summary: 客戶詢問是否提供新進員工的教育訓練資源或線上教學安排。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶詢問是否提供新進員工的教育訓練資源或線上教學安排。
cases.notes: 標準 general 情境：教育訓練資源詢問。

cases.input_text: 我們的 14 天試用快到期了，但這禮拜團隊在忙年度稽核沒空好好測試，想請問可不可以延長試用期，或是先暫緩自動轉正式訂閱扣款？
cases.draft_summary: 客戶請求延長試用期或暫緩試用到期後的自動轉正式訂閱扣款。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶請求延長試用期或暫緩試用到期後的自動轉正式訂閱扣款。
cases.notes: 同時提出兩個可能解法（延長試用／暫緩扣款），需要客服判斷哪個更符合客戶真正需求，非單一動作的請求。

cases.input_text: 我門的系統一直讀取ㄓㄨㄥ，工單頁面卡在轉圈圈超過五分鐘還沒好，是不是你們主機又秀逗了？拜託快點修好謝謝。
cases.draft_summary: 客戶反映工單頁面持續讀取轉圈無法完成，疑似系統異常。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶反映工單頁面持續讀取轉圈無法完成，疑似系統異常。
cases.notes: 刻意含注音文殘留字（「ㄓㄨㄥ」＝中／讀取中）與錯字（「我門」＝我們），測試模型對非標準輸入的穩健度。

cases.input_text: 目前我們帳號只有我一個人是管理員身分，想請問要怎麼再指定一位同事也擔任管理員，這樣我休假的時候他也可以處理帳號設定的事情。
cases.draft_summary: 客戶詢問如何新增第二位帳號管理員角色。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶詢問如何新增第二位帳號管理員角色。
cases.notes: 標準 account 情境：新增管理員角色詢問。

cases.input_text: Hi team, we recently moved offices and need our billing address updated on file before the next invoice goes out. New address: 4th Floor, 88 King Street, Toronto, ON. Can you confirm once it's changed?
cases.draft_summary: Customer requests an update to their billing address before the next invoice is generated.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests an update to their billing address before the next invoice is generated.
cases.notes: Standard billing case: complete, unambiguous address-update request.

cases.input_text: We just rotated our webhook signing secret in the NebulaDesk dashboard, and now every incoming webhook fails our HMAC signature check on our end. Did the payload format change recently, or is this something on our side?
cases.draft_summary: Customer reports webhook signature verification failures after rotating the signing secret.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports webhook signature verification failures after rotating the signing secret.
cases.notes: Standard technical case: integration failure tied to a specific recent action (secret rotation).

cases.input_text: I changed my own role from Owner to Admin by mistake while cleaning up permissions, and now I can't access billing settings or invite new admins. Nobody else on the team has Owner access either. Can someone restore Owner permissions on my account?
cases.draft_summary: Customer accidentally downgraded their own role and lost access to owner-level settings, with no other Owner on the team, blocking billing access too.
cases.expected_summary: Customer accidentally downgraded their own role and lost access to owner-level settings, with no other Owner on the team, blocking billing access too.
cases.notes: Self-inflicted permission lockout that also blocks billing access -- a genuine account/billing boundary case with real urgency.

cases.input_text: Small ask from our night-shift support team: any plans to add a dark mode to the agent dashboard? A few of them have mentioned eye strain during long shifts.
cases.draft_summary: Customer requests a dark mode option for the agent dashboard.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests a dark mode option for the agent dashboard.
cases.notes: Standard general case: feature request, no urgency.

cases.input_text: We meant to click 'upgrade to Pro' but ended up on the annual Enterprise plan instead and got charged $3,600 today. This was purely a UI mis-click on our end -- could we get this refunded and switched back to our previous monthly Pro plan?
cases.draft_summary: Customer accidentally purchased the annual Enterprise plan and requests a refund plus reversion to their previous Pro plan.
cases.expected_summary: Customer accidentally purchased the annual Enterprise plan and requests a refund plus reversion to their previous Pro plan.
cases.notes: Standard billing case: clear refund request with acknowledged root cause.

cases.input_text: Every weekday around 9am our integration starts throwing 429 rate-limit errors on the ticket-creation endpoint, then clears up by 9:30. Is our current plan's rate limit just too low for our ticket volume, or is there a burst allowance we're not configuring correctly?
cases.draft_summary: Customer's integration hits rate-limit errors during a daily traffic spike, unsure whether it's a plan limit or a configuration issue.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's integration hits rate-limit errors during a daily traffic spike, unsure whether it's a plan limit or a configuration issue.
cases.notes: Customer explicitly frames two plausible causes (plan limit vs. misconfiguration) and can't tell which -- genuinely needs investigation to resolve.

cases.input_text: Our current account Owner is leaving the company at the end of this week. Can you walk us through the proper way to transfer account ownership to me before his access is revoked on Friday?
cases.draft_summary: Customer requests guidance on transferring account ownership ahead of the current Owner's departure.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests guidance on transferring account ownership ahead of the current Owner's departure.
cases.notes: Standard account case: ownership transfer procedure request.

cases.input_text: Cool, another outage. Love it.
cases.draft_summary: Customer sarcastically comments on an apparent service outage.
cases.expected_summary: Customer sarcastically comments on an apparent service outage.
cases.notes: Very short input combined with sarcasm -- tests whether the model is misled by surface-positive words like 'love it' into missing the underlying outage complaint.〔2026-07-20 labeling principle: concrete, troubleshootable symptoms → technical (cf. case-034); pure venting with no diagnostic detail → general.〕

cases.input_text: If we add 5 more agent seats halfway through our billing month, are we charged the full seat price immediately or prorated for the remaining days? Trying to budget correctly before we invite the new hires.
cases.draft_summary: Customer asks whether adding seats mid-cycle is billed at full price or prorated.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether adding seats mid-cycle is billed at full price or prorated.
cases.notes: Standard billing case: proration policy question.

cases.input_text: When we try to export ticket data for a full quarter (about 40k tickets), the export just spins and eventually times out. Exporting a single month works fine. Is there a size limit we're hitting?
cases.draft_summary: Customer's large-date-range CSV export times out, while smaller exports succeed, suggesting a size limit.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's large-date-range CSV export times out, while smaller exports succeed, suggesting a size limit.
cases.notes: Standard technical case: export failure with a clear repro pattern (large range fails, small range works).

cases.input_text: We're trying to remove a former employee from our team member list, but the 'Remove' button is greyed out. He still shows as 'Active' even though we deactivated his SSO account on our end weeks ago.
cases.draft_summary: Customer is unable to remove a former employee whose team member entry remains active despite SSO deactivation.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is unable to remove a former employee whose team member entry remains active despite SSO deactivation.
cases.notes: Standard account case: offboarding blocked by a UI/state inconsistency.

cases.input_text: Our security team needs to review your SOC 2 Type II report before we can move forward with the enterprise contract. Is that something you can share under NDA?
cases.draft_summary: Customer requests access to the SOC 2 Type II report for a security review ahead of an enterprise contract.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests access to the SOC 2 Type II report for a security review ahead of an enterprise contract.
cases.notes: Standard general case: compliance-documentation request tied to a sales process.

cases.input_text: Our sales rep quoted us EUR 1,200/year, but the invoice that came through is billed in USD at what looks like a slightly unfavorable exchange rate. Can billing confirm which currency our contract is actually locked to?
cases.draft_summary: Customer flags a currency discrepancy between the sales quote (EUR) and the actual invoice (USD).
cases.expected_summary: Customer flags a currency discrepancy between the sales quote (EUR) and the actual invoice (USD).
cases.notes: Currency mixing (EUR quote vs. USD invoice) with an implicit dispute over which figure is contractually correct -- needs a definitive answer, not just an explanation.

cases.input_text: None of our agents have received push notifications for new tickets on the mobile app since Tuesday's update. Notifications are enabled in both the app and iOS settings. This is a big problem for our after-hours on-call rotation.
cases.draft_summary: Customer reports mobile push notifications have stopped since a recent app update, despite correct settings.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports mobile push notifications have stopped since a recent app update, despite correct settings.
cases.notes: Standard technical case: regression tied to a specific app update, settings already ruled out by the customer.

cases.input_text: We tried to set up SSO and got an error saying our domain is already claimed by another NebulaDesk account. We only have one account that we know of -- could this be a leftover from an old trial someone on our team signed up for?
cases.draft_summary: Customer's SSO setup fails due to a domain-claim conflict, possibly from a forgotten old trial account.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's SSO setup fails due to a domain-claim conflict, possibly from a forgotten old trial account.
cases.notes: Standard account case: SSO domain conflict with a plausible self-diagnosed cause.

cases.input_text: Honestly, your pricing page is really hard to parse -- I can't tell what's included in Pro vs Business without opening three different tooltips. Could someone just send me a plain comparison table?
cases.draft_summary: Customer finds the pricing page confusing and requests a plain plan comparison table.
cases.expected_summary: Customer finds the pricing page confusing and requests a plain plan comparison table.
cases.notes: Standard general case: UX complaint paired with a concrete, actionable ask.

cases.input_text: We signed up for the Business plan expecting to onboard a bigger team, but we've only been using about 15% of the seats for three months now. What's the process to downgrade to Starter without losing our historical data?
cases.draft_summary: Customer wants to downgrade due to low seat usage and asks about the process, including data retention.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to downgrade due to low seat usage and asks about the process, including data retention.
cases.notes: Downgrade request (billing) intertwined with a data-retention condition (account/data) -- the answer has to cover both halves to actually satisfy the customer.〔2026-07-20 human-verified: kept billing; paired with case-031 (same construct), both unified under billing — the primary action (downgrade) is a billing change, data retention is the rider.〕

cases.input_text: All the response-time charts on our dashboard seem to be in UTC, but our whole team is in Taipei. Is there a timezone setting we're missing, or does the reporting module not support local timezones yet?
cases.draft_summary: Customer's dashboard charts display in UTC instead of their local timezone, unclear if a setting is missing.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's dashboard charts display in UTC instead of their local timezone, unclear if a setting is missing.
cases.notes: Standard technical case: reporting/timezone configuration question.

cases.input_text: We enabled mandatory 2FA for the whole workspace this morning and now half the team can't get past the QR code screen -- it just says 'invalid code' no matter what we enter. Can you help us troubleshoot or temporarily disable the requirement?
cases.draft_summary: Customer's mandatory 2FA rollout is locking out half the team with persistent 'invalid code' errors.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's mandatory 2FA rollout is locking out half the team with persistent 'invalid code' errors.
cases.notes: Standard account case: security-feature rollout gone wrong, high urgency but clearly an account/access issue.

cases.input_text: It would be great if tickets just... worked properly. Not sure what else to say.
cases.draft_summary: Customer expresses vague dissatisfaction without specifying what is malfunctioning.
cases.expected_summary: Customer expresses vague dissatisfaction without specifying what is malfunctioning.
cases.notes: Deliberately vague, low-information complaint -- tests whether the model forces a specific, defensible category guess rather than stalling, while still flagging (in the summary) that detail is missing.

cases.input_text: Our accounting department needs a signed W-9 on file for you as a vendor before they can process this year's payment. Could someone from billing send that over?
cases.draft_summary: Customer's accounting team requests a signed W-9 form to process vendor payment.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's accounting team requests a signed W-9 form to process vendor payment.
cases.notes: Standard billing case: vendor-documentation request tied to payment processing.

cases.input_text: When we update a ticket's status via the API and immediately GET the same ticket, it still shows the old status for a few seconds before catching up. Is there a caching layer we should account for, or is this expected eventual consistency?
cases.draft_summary: Customer observes stale data briefly returned by the API right after a ticket update, asking whether it's expected caching behavior.
cases.expected_summary: Customer observes stale data briefly returned by the API right after a ticket update, asking whether it's expected caching behavior.
cases.notes: Standard technical case: API consistency-model question, well-specified repro.

cases.input_text: Right now every agent with 'Admin' role can also see our full billing history and card details, which our finance team isn't comfortable with. Is there a way to split billing visibility into its own permission?
cases.draft_summary: Customer wants billing visibility separated from the Admin role into its own granular permission.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants billing visibility separated from the Admin role into its own granular permission.
cases.notes: Standard account case: permission-granularity request.

cases.input_text: Does NebulaDesk have any native integration with Linear for engineering escalations, or would we need to build something custom with the API?
cases.draft_summary: Customer asks whether NebulaDesk natively integrates with Linear, or requires a custom API integration.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether NebulaDesk natively integrates with Linear, or requires a custom API integration.
cases.notes: Standard general case: pre-sales/integration capability question.

cases.input_text: For an internal audit we need copies of every invoice from the last 24 months. Is there a way to bulk-download those from the billing portal, or do we need to request them individually?
cases.draft_summary: Customer requests bulk access to two years of historical invoices for an internal audit.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests bulk access to two years of historical invoices for an internal audit.
cases.notes: Standard billing case: bulk historical invoice request.

cases.input_text: New tickets created in the last hour or so aren't showing up when we search for them, even by exact ticket number, but they do appear if we browse the list manually. Feels like a search indexing delay.
cases.draft_summary: Customer notices recently created tickets are missing from search results despite appearing in the manual list, suggesting an indexing delay.
cases.expected_summary: Customer notices recently created tickets are missing from search results despite appearing in the manual list, suggesting an indexing delay.
cases.notes: Customer offers their own hypothesis (indexing delay) that is plausible but unconfirmed -- the model has to classify without knowing if that hypothesis is actually correct.

cases.input_text: I need to update the email address tied to my account -- I'm switching from my old personal email to my new work email before our IT team locks down external logins. What's the process?
cases.draft_summary: Customer requests to change the email address associated with their account ahead of an IT policy change.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests to change the email address associated with their account ahead of an IT policy change.
cases.notes: Standard account case: account email change request.

cases.input_text: Just wanted to say thanks to whoever ran our onboarding call last week -- our team went from confused to fully set up in under an hour. Really appreciated the patience with our 100 questions.
cases.draft_summary: Customer thanks the team for a helpful onboarding call.
cases.expected_summary: Customer thanks the team for a helpful onboarding call.
cases.notes: Standard general case: pure thank-you note, no action needed.

cases.input_text: Hi 你好，我們的 invoice 這個月的 due date 是幾號？我看 billing portal 上面沒有寫清楚，麻煩 confirm 一下，謝謝！
cases.draft_summary: 客戶詢問本月 invoice 的付款截止日期，表示 billing portal 上未清楚顯示。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶詢問本月 invoice 的付款截止日期，表示 billing portal 上未清楚顯示。
cases.notes: 標準 billing 情境的中英夾雜版本：截止日期查詢。

cases.input_text: 我們的 API integration 昨天開始一直回傳 500 error，但 sandbox environment 測試完全正常，只有 production 會這樣，你們那邊 server 是不是有 deploy 什麼更新？
cases.draft_summary: 客戶反映 production 環境的 API 整合出現 500 錯誤，sandbox 測試正常，懷疑近期有伺服器更新導致。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶反映 production 環境的 API 整合出現 500 錯誤，sandbox 測試正常，懷疑近期有伺服器更新導致。
cases.notes: 客戶提出具體假設（近期部署導致），但無法自行確認，需後台查證，屬跨語言的模糊技術案例。

cases.input_text: 麻煩幫我把我的 role 從 agent 升成 admin，我們主管 approve 了，這是他的信 forward 附在下面，謝謝協助！
cases.draft_summary: 客戶請求將自己的角色從 agent 升級為 admin，並附上主管核准的轉發信件。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶請求將自己的角色從 agent 升級為 admin，並附上主管核准的轉發信件。
cases.notes: 標準 account 情境的中英夾雜版本：角色升級請求，附核准佐證。

cases.input_text: 想請問你們的 uptime SLA 是多少 %？我們老闆問我 vendor evaluation 的時候要附這個數字，麻煩提供一下官方的 documentation 連結。
cases.draft_summary: 客戶詢問服務的 uptime SLA 百分比，用於供應商評估文件。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶詢問服務的 uptime SLA 百分比，用於供應商評估文件。
cases.notes: 標準 general 情境的中英夾雜版本：合約/評估用的 SLA 數字詢問。

cases.input_text: 官網明明寫 $29/month，結果我這邊 credit card statement 顯示扣了 NT$1,250，這個匯率也太「佛心」了吧？麻煩解釋一下這中間的計算方式。
cases.draft_summary: 客戶質疑官網標示美金月費與信用卡實際扣款台幣金額之間的匯率換算，語氣帶諷刺。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶質疑官網標示美金月費與信用卡實際扣款台幣金額之間的匯率換算，語氣帶諷刺。
cases.notes: 中英夾雜＋幣別混用（USD／TWD）＋反諷（「佛心」為反話），是整份資料集中語言與語氣複雜度最高的案例之一。〔2026-07-20 定案原則：與 case-020 對照——已發生信用卡扣款→billing；未購買的 pre-sale 詢價爭議→general。〕

cases.input_text: 我們 IT 部門在 setup SSO 的時候，metadata file upload 一直失敗，錯誤訊息只寫 'invalid certificate format'，但我們是直接從 Okta 匯出的標準 XML，想請你們 check 一下是不是 parser 那邊有問題。
cases.draft_summary: 客戶在設定 SSO 時上傳 Okta 匯出的 metadata 檔案持續失敗，錯誤訊息顯示憑證格式無效，懷疑是解析器問題。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶在設定 SSO 時上傳 Okta 匯出的 metadata 檔案持續失敗，錯誤訊息顯示憑證格式無效，懷疑是解析器問題。
cases.notes: 標準 technical 情境的中英夾雜版本：SSO metadata 上傳失敗，客戶已提供錯誤訊息與排除線索。

cases.input_text: 我們是 non-profit 組織，想請問有沒有 discount 或 special pricing？我們的 budget 真的很有限，但很需要一個 proper 的 ticketing system。
cases.draft_summary: 客戶為非營利組織，詢問是否提供優惠折扣或特殊定價方案。
cases.expected_summary: 客戶為非營利組織，詢問是否提供優惠折扣或特殊定價方案。
cases.notes: 介於 general 詢價與 billing 折扣申請之間的模糊案例：既是產品評估詢問，也隱含具體的價格協商請求。
